title: Making Pasta, Step by Step
weekly_note: In this record, they open a flour package, knead and stretch dough, chop green vegetables, add greens and pasta to a pot, then taste the food with a spoon.

chapters.heading: Opening the flour
chapters.caption: They open a flour package on the worktop.

chapters.heading: Kneading dough
chapters.caption: They press and knead the dough with both hands.

chapters.heading: Flouring the dough
chapters.caption: They dust the dough with flour.

chapters.heading: Stretching dough
chapters.caption: They stretch the dough by hand.

chapters.heading: Chopping greens
chapters.caption: They chop green vegetables on a board.

chapters.heading: Adding greens
chapters.caption: They put the green vegetables into a pot.

chapters.heading: Adding pasta
chapters.caption: They put pasta into a pot.

chapters.heading: Tasting the food
chapters.caption: They use a spoon to taste the food.
